source_sha: e43a599 (release-test binaries; identity binding+freshness PASS; tree clean)
protocol: interleaved randomized order, idle-gated, each repetition pinned to one logical core at high priority, 5 warm-up + 5 measured reps

fixture_identity.byte_identity: MECHANICALLY VERIFIED: every run of every arm self-validates its serialized bytes against the production SerializeSnapshotTo output by full memcmp and fails the process (exit 3) on any mismatch; all 30 processes exited 0. Names, name lengths, counts, and generation token constant by construction.

session2_total_spread_pct.verdict: valid session: identical binaries agree to 0.01% in arm medians; the spread is run-to-run variation under residual user load (tight clusters ~4-5% with one load-correlated outlier per arm)

same_binary_noise.floor_used_for_decision: ~13-25% same-binary run-to-run total spread (session 2, most generous reading); historical 5-7% is reference only

decision.verdict: OUTCOME A for the export/build+serialize side; OUTCOME C for the parse side
decision.export_side: control total median 62.29 ms (n=12, spread 22.5%) vs export-eliminated 35.12 ms (n=6, spread 21.2%): -43.6% with NON-OVERLAPPING distributions (worst treatment run 40.1 ms beats best control run 53.4 ms by 25%). Stage split: build 25.67 -> 10.26 ms (-60%), serialize 14.16 -> 6.15 ms (-56%). This is a constant-payload, allocation-only representation effect (owning per-entry wstrings + scattered map nodes vs one contiguous offset/length pool) and it clearly exceeds the fresh same-binary noise floor. Not outcome B: payload size is byte-identical by construction, so the historical conflated gain is NOT what is measured here.
decision.parse_side: parse-eliminated total 53.89 ms (n=6) vs control 62.29 ms (n=12): -13.5% with heavily OVERLAPPING distributions (49.4-66.1 vs 53.4-67.4). Parse stage 15.79 vs 21.36 ms (-26%) sits inside the same-binary stage spreads (31-45%). Inside the noise floor -> outcome C: production parse/UI representation stays unchanged.
decision.consequence: Enter design D6 outcome A: smallest production change capturing the measured export side (per-entry owning strings eliminated while building the bytes), preferring direct serialization from interned or generation-owned names. Snapshot format stays version 3 (bytes already proven identical).
